pages.title: White Hole Fragment
pages.text: A shard of a white hole, the time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter, from which matter and light only ever pour out. General relativity allows them, though nature seems shy. It feels like holding a pressure that pushes my fingers apart.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The White Hole Emitter took Ejecta Rock and Primordial Ejecta from the far side of a horizon and pushed Hawking radiation through them in reverse. What crystallised could not be entered: a white hole in miniature.
